findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_limits, list_sources, find_designations, screen_species, cite_document, build_dwc_archive, audit_archive, search, fetch · Private data: read_certificate, get_permit, list_permits, check_dmr, fill_dmr, map_to_darwin_core, cite_document, build_dwc_archive, audit_archive, screen_exposure, export_limits, fetch, list_sites, add_document, ask_site · Public sink: check_dmr, fill_dmr, build_dwc_archive, screen_exposure · Destructive: read_certificate, audit_archive.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_limits, list_sources, find_designations, screen_species, cite_document, build_dwc_archive, audit_archive, search, fetch · Private data: read_certificate, get_permit, list_permits, check_dmr, fill_dmr, map_to_darwin_core, cite_document, build_dwc_archive, audit_archive, screen_exposure, export_limits, fetch, list_sites, add_document, ask_site · Public sink: check_dmr, fill_dmr, build_dwc_archive, screen_exposure · Destructive: read_certificate, audit_archive

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
